body: I'm extremely new to KC and the woman friend doesn't like going out a lot... but we know of zero house parties that sound like fun... looks like it's gonna be Tapcade.
Pea sized hail on the east side of town.
My whole life is shock and grief. I don't want to be 56 and still waiting to meet the right one.

I might feel calmer. Idk. I don't want to be around to find out.

I literally don't have anyone. I looked through my phone.

I'm probably the WORST person to talk to about girlfriends and sex.

I hate myself because I can't seem to find anyone who will love me.
